title: The Ice Witch
text: A witch of the Deep Cold, blue-lipped and beautiful, with frost growing on her eyelashes like lace. She offers to freeze a wound so it will never bleed again. Forever, she says, and touches her own chest, where something is frozen and does not beat.

outcomes.text: It stops hurting. It stops feeling.
She shrugs and is gone in the snow, and her parting breath frosts every buckle in the party brittle.

options.label: The wisest trades her a secret instead.

outcomes.text: She gives a charm against cold.
